title: Simulating Multi-Stakeholder Decision-Making with Generative Agents in Urban Planning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study focuses on evaluating the influence of demographic factors (race, gender, age), life-value data, and communication on collective decision-making in an urban planning simulation.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a component of the study.
